comparison.target_clears: higher-better: candidate - max > max - min; lower-better: min - candidate > max - min. Strict: a candidate at exactly max + range (min - range) does not clear.
comparison.guard_loses: higher-better: candidate < min; lower-better: candidate > max. Strict: a candidate equal to the bound is inside the envelope and does not lose.
comparison.counts: metrics recorded as n / n_total are compared on the integers, never the float value (the float is read only to cross-check it against its own counts, and a disagreement refuses). For candidate c = a/b, min = e/f, max = g/h: clears (higher-better) iff a*f*h + e*b*h > 2*g*b*f; clears (lower-better) iff 2*e*b*h > a*f*h + g*b*f; loses (higher-better) iff a*f < e*b; loses (lower-better) iff a*h > g*b. Exact i128 arithmetic.
comparison.needle_worst_bucket: the minimum of the five depth buckets (needle_hunk_recall.depth.{0-20%,20-40%,40-60%,60-80%,80-100%}, or needle_hunk_recall.control.<L>.depth.* on the length-control row) as an exact fraction, cross-checked against the gate's (or control's) recorded value, exactly as qd-post-f-rules needle_worst does; then compared as a count
comparison.paired_margin: paired_margin_vs_linear.choice.code.defect_class records value = mean(model_correct - control_correct) over n_total rows (python/qd_train/eval_harness.py:252-253, paired_margin_test), so value * n_total is an integer m in [-n_total, n_total]. The checker recovers m, refuses unless m / n_total reproduces the recorded value, and compares the signed fractions m / n_total by the count forms above. F seed 0: 873/2304 = 0.37890625 (c89b89a1).
comparison.ece: ece.family.code.defect_class.choice.k4 is a float with no count (n = n_total = 2304 is the row count). It is compared on the recorded f64, lower is better, and is a guard only (no arm targets it).

outcomes.fires:j6f: J6(f) wins and J6(d)-v4 does not: F' runs J6(f)'s recipe
outcomes.fires:j6dv4: J6(d)-v4 wins and J6(f) does not: F' runs J6(d)-v4's recipe
outcomes.quiet: both arms were evaluated on every required row and metric and neither wins: no F'; Fable Q2 then re-plans from J7''s avg / ens3 / avg-np rows
outcomes.refused: (a) both arms win (they cannot win on the same metric: their targets are disjoint): the human decides; two one-seed wins are never combined into an untested recipe; or (b) any required row is missing, doubled or not completed, any required metric is absent or not ran, a recorded value disagrees with its own counts, or an identity or comparability check fails. Never quiet in case (b), including when one arm would win on its own, since a both-win cannot then be ruled out.
outcomes.exit_codes: 0 with the word on stdout for fires:j6f, fires:j6dv4, quiet; 3 with 'refused' on stdout for every refusal; the JSON (per-arm detail, every input ledger's sha256) is written to --out and stderr in every case
